o1: Enables sodium channel activity. Predicted to enable ligand-gated sodium channel activity. Involved in defecation, ultradian rhythm, and regulation of growth. Predicted to be involved in regulation of membrane potential. Is located in nuclear membrane and plasma membrane. Is expressed in intestine. Orthologous to human ASIC1 (acid sensing ion channel subunit 1); ASIC2 (acid sensing ion channel subunit 2); and ASIC3 (acid sensing ion channel subunit 3).
